 **Product Management, Enablement, Sales, Professional Services, Customer Success, and Partners** 
 .
 





 This role combines deep functional and process domain expertise (In Supply Chain and Manufacturing space) with technical application architecture, consultative selling, and ecosystem enablement. You will support Anaplan’s GTM Teams on all engagements that require your domain expertise, from initial demand generation programs to initial discovery and through to implementation, and expansion.
 





 Preferred Location \- Mumbai / Bangalore / Gurgaon.
 





**Key Responsibilities** 






 Partner seamlessly with Anaplan’s GTM Teams to ensure seamless integration of Supply Chain Enterprise Planning Applications into Anaplan’s GTM motion by:
 



* Contribute to the creation and delivery of scalable knowledge\-sharing initiatives including compelling sales programs, executive presentations, ROI insights and customer success stories, and enablement assets (training materials, technical guides, evaluation frameworks) to empower internal teams and partners.
* Distill deep domain expertise and positioning into crisp, actionable sales tactics. Ensuring Supply Chain Applications presentations and demonstrations are clearly aligned with prospect and customer requirements. Support all stages of complex sales opportunities both onsite and remotely as a technical, process, and architectural expert. Act as ambassador to and advocate for application customers post\-sale, driving expansion.
* Support our Platform, Application and AI Teams with application design and best practices, pre\-market testing and early adopter customers. Capture structured feedback and translate field insights from customer, prospect, and partner engagements to Product Management to shape application roadmap priorities
* Support Anaplan, Analyst and Industry engagements and events as a key thought leader, including producing thought leadership content across diverse media. Contribute to market insights, whitepapers, top\-of\-mind and high\-impact use cases for customer discovery and executive presentations.
* Collaborating with the Competitive Intelligence Team to deliver competitive differentiation in Anaplan’s positioning and value proposition, sharpening battlecards, and providing win reports that drive useable insights and tactics.



 Key Metrics
 
* Adoption and successful completion of enablement by GTM Teams.
* Number of presentations, demonstrations, and other supporting activities of your Domain Applications.
* Total revenue, deal volume, and pipeline value associated with or influenced by Domain Applications.
* Qualitative evaluations and ratings from our GTM Teams.



 Qualifications
 
* **More than a decade of experience in Supply Chain Planning space**
* Demonstrable understanding of Anaplan’s platform and its applications to solve complex business challenges (Or similar EPM / Enterprise Planning / Supply \& Demand Planning solutions in the market)
* **Deep domain knowledge of Supply \& demand planning** 
 , at strategic, operational and headcount levels, the market of Supply Chain focused \- Enterprise performance management, planning and reporting solutions, required processes and best practices, and the key stakeholders and decision\-makers.
* **Understanding of product management, enablement and GTM operations.**
* Proven experience in consultative selling or strategic advisory roles, preferably within SaaS or enterprise software, with the ability to ask the right questions, manage objections, and guide the sales journey from start to implementation and expansion.
* **Have background working in Manufacturing industry – preferable to have worked directly in a manufacturing company in the past before transitioning to SaaS or Enterprise Software organizations.**
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and knowledge\-sharing skills, with a demonstrated exceptional ability in presenting compelling content, performing product demonstrations, leading workshops, and developing enablement programs.
* A results\-driven mindset, able to collaborate across teams, with a focus on contributing deliverables of the highest possible quality and impact.



**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)** 




 We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!
 



 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  
 



**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer**

Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.

* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.



 All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

description:
**About Us**
 At Check Point, what you do matters. Every day, we protect over 100,000 organizations worldwide from increasingly sophisticated cyber and AI\-driven threats, securing their AI transformation.
   

  

 Our prevention\-first approach safeguards hybrid networks, cloud environments, digital workspaces, and AI systems, stopping attacks before they happen.
   

  

 This is where innovation meets real\-world impact. You’ll help customers across industries operate with confidence in a rapidly changing digital world, working alongside smart, curious people who take ownership, challenge assumptions, and solve complex problems.
   

  

 We’re proud to be recognized by TIME, Newsweek, and Forbes for excellence and workplace culture.
   

  

 What really sets Check Point apart is the opportunity to grow, contribute, and help companies navigate their AI transformation securely.
   

  

 If you’re excited to work at the forefront of AI\-driven security on a global scale, this is the place to do it.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Your Role in a Nutshell**
 No two days are the same. You'll work hands\-on with market\-leading technologies, diagnose customers' toughest security challenges, and design solutions alongside partners — playing a central role in high\-impact projects from discovery through delivery. If you thrive at the intersection of deep technical expertise and real business impact, this is your seat at the table.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Drive the win. Partner with partner sales teams to identify prospects, progress opportunities, and demonstrate Check Point's value proposition where it matters most — in front of the customer.
* Be the face of Check Point. Present at partner\-led customer events, workshops, and industry forums, bringing our story and our technology to life.
* Prove it out. Lead and co\-execute POCs and technical assessments alongside partner technical and presales teams, turning prospects into believers.
* Lead with value. Guide conversations that uncover real business problems and translate them into winning technical solutions — not just feature lists.
* Be the trusted advisor. Serve as a go\-to cybersecurity resource for partner technical communities, fielding tough technical questions and articulating solution benefits with confidence.
* Stay sharp. Keep a pulse on cybersecurity trends and the competitive landscape so every engagement is informed by what's happening now.
* Support the full cycle. Help partners respond to RFIs/RFPs, share best practices, and manage POCs so every customer gets an excellent experience from first conversation to close.
* Enable others. Train and enable partners and customers on the latest security technologies, multiplying your impact across every account you touch.
* Grow the account. Position Check Point's portfolio to maximize cross\-sell and upsell opportunities within partner accounts.
* Deliver excellence. Build solution designs and high\-impact proposals that reinforce Check Point's reputation as a security leader.
* Represent the brand. Show up at cybersecurity events and live demos as a credible, engaging voice for Check Point.


**Qualifications**
**What You'll Bring**
* 8\+ years in technology organizations, including 4–6\+ years in systems engineering, presales, or partner engineering roles
* A genuinely customer\-centric mindset and a commitment to delivering an excellent customer experience
* A hands\-on attitude — you're willing to roll up your sleeves and work through technical blockers yourself
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving instincts
* Solid understanding of networking technologies, application architectures, and solution design
* Experience building end\-to\-end security solutions spanning network, endpoint, and cloud
* Excellent communication and presentation skills — you can flex between technical depth and executive clarity
* Relevant certifications preferred (e.g., CCNP, CISSP, CCSA, CCSE)
* An engineering degree in Computer Science, Electronics, or a related discipline


**Why This Role**
 This is a role for someone who wants more than a technical title — you'll shape how partners and customers experience Check Point, own high\-visibility engagements end to end, and be recognized as the technical expert people turn to when the stakes are high. If you're energized by variety, ownership, and solving real security problems alongside great partners, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior Solutions Architect
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
   

  

 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high\-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co\-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
   

  

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025\. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.


**An Overview Of This Role**
 As a Senior Solutions Architect on GitLab's India team, you'll be a trusted advisor to prospects, customers, and partners across India. You'll help them understand how GitLab's AI\-powered DevSecOps platform addresses technical requirements and business goals across the software development lifecycle. This role supports Commercial and Enterprise segments in India's Southern Region. Experience with Global Capability Centers (GCCs), Digital Native organizations, and startups is highly valued given the accounts you'll support.
   

  

 You'll partner closely with Account Executives and cross\-functional teams to own technical evaluations, including proofs of value and workshops, shape solution architectures, and bring customer feedback to Product Management. You'll also occasionally support regional go\-to\-market partners that provide Professional Services. Your work will help customers adopt GitLab successfully, support revenue growth through solution selling, and build long\-term, trusted relationships.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Lead technical discovery, demonstrations, and validation to show how GitLab's AI\-powered DevSecOps platform meets customers' technical and business needs across the software development lifecycle.
* Own the technical evaluation process, including solution design, proofs of concept or value, workshops, and technical contributions to tenders, audits, and value stream assessments.
* Collaborate with Account Executives and regional sales teams across Commercial and Enterprise segments to shape account strategies for new customer acquisition and expansion, with a focus on GCC, Digital Native, and startup accounts.
* Support regional go\-to\-market partners that provide Professional Services, helping them deliver consistent technical guidance and apply effective practices during partner\-led engagements.
* Represent GitLab at online and in\-person marketing events, including webinars, industry events, presentations, roundtables, panels, demonstration days, and hackathons.
* Build trusted relationships with technical practitioners and business leaders, guide GitLab\-driven transformation, and help customers become GitLab advocates.
* Advise customers on modern software development, continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD), security, and cloud practices to improve their return on investment.
* Share customer feedback, use cases, and competitive insights with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing while continuing to build expertise and reusable guidance in GitLab, DevSecOps, AI, and cloud technologies.


**What You’ll Bring**
* Experience guiding Commercial and Enterprise customers through solution design and evaluation in technical presales, consulting, or a similar role.
* Experience working with India's GCCs, Digital Native organizations, and startups is highly valued.
* Knowledge of the end\-to\-end software development lifecycle, including modern DevSecOps practices and CI/CD workflows.
* Hands\-on experience with GitLab or comparable source control, CI/CD, and collaboration platforms, with the ability to connect platform capabilities to customer use cases.
* Practical knowledge of cloud computing concepts and related technologies, including deployment, security, and operations options.
* Ability to lead proofs of concept or value, contribute to tenders or audits, and design and run workshops or value stream assessments.
* Clear technical communication and presentation skills, with the ability to adapt your message for practitioners and senior business and technical decision\-makers.
* Skill in building trusted relationships, listening with empathy, advocating for customers, collaborating with go\-to\-market or Professional Services partners, and continuously learning new technologies.


**About The Team**
 The Solutions Architect team is part of GitLab's Sales organization and serves as the technical counterpart to Account Executives. This role focuses on Commercial and Enterprise opportunities across India's Southern Region and works with Account Executives, the broader go\-to\-market team, and regional partners that provide Professional Services. The team advises on architecture, runs technical evaluations such as proofs of value, and guides customers through digital transformation. We collaborate asynchronously with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to share effective practices, create reusable technical resources, and represent the voice of the customer. Our focus is helping customers modernize software delivery, adopt GitLab at scale, and navigate a changing AI and DevSecOps landscape.
   

  

**How GitLab Supports Full\-Time Employees**
* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well\-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation \& Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave


 Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification.  6 Months – 3 Years

 Immediate Joiners Preferred
   

  

**About Mitra Learn**
 Mitra Learn Pvt. Ltd. is an
 **EdTech and HRTech company** 
 focused on building digital solutions across learning, career development, talent, and workforce management. We work on practical products that help learners, professionals, institutions, and businesses.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a
 **B2B Sales Executive** 
 who can identify business opportunities, connect with potential clients, understand their requirements, and sell our
 **SaaS, ERP, HRM, and technology solutions** 
 .
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who enjoys speaking with businesses, generating opportunities, conducting product demonstrations, and taking sales conversations from prospecting to closure.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities
   

  

* Identify and generate new B2B sales opportunities.
* Research companies and identify relevant decision\-makers.
* Connect with business owners, HR leaders, founders, and other stakeholders.
* Conduct outbound calls, LinkedIn outreach, email outreach, and other prospecting activities.
* Understand client requirements and recommend suitable solutions.
* Conduct product presentations and demonstrations.
* Manage prospects throughout the complete sales cycle.
* Prepare proposals, quotations, and commercial discussions.
* Handle negotiations and work towards closing deals.
* Follow up consistently with prospects and maintain the sales pipeline.
* Maintain accurate lead and client information in CRM systems.
* Build and maintain long\-term client relationships.
* Achieve monthly sales and revenue targets.
* Coordinate with Product, Marketing, HR, and Business Development teams.
* Identify new market opportunities for SaaS, EdTech, and HRTech solutions.


**Required Experience \& Skills**
* 6 months – 3 years of experience in B2B Sales, SaaS Sales, Business Development, or related roles.
* Experience in selling EdTech, HRTech, ERP, HRM, CRM, or SaaS solutions will be an advantage.
* Good understanding of the B2B sales process.
* Experience in prospecting, cold calling, LinkedIn outreach, product demos, and follow\-ups.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Good negotiation and closing skills.
* Strong lead generation and client acquisition abilities.
* Ability to understand customer requirements and present suitable solutions.
* Target\-oriented and self\-motivated.
* Good CRM and sales pipeline management skills.


 Why Join Mitra Learn?
   

  

* Opportunity to work on real\-world EdTech and HRTech products.
* Exposure to B2B SaaS sales and technology solutions.
* Opportunity to work directly with clients and decision\-makers.
* Growth\-oriented work environment.
* Opportunity to take ownership and contribute to business growth.


**Important:** 
 This is a
 **Work From Office** 
 role based at
 **Kudlu Gate, Bangalore** 
 . Candidates who are comfortable with the location and salary range of
 **₹17,000–₹25,000/month** 
 are encouraged to apply.
 **Immediate joiners are preferred.**
